user.title: Set up BatteryBrain
user.description:
BatteryBrain automatically finds all batteries in Home Assistant, learns how each one drains and tells you which ones need attention — including an estimate of when they will be empty.

No settings are needed. Existing history is imported from the recorder, so most batteries are evaluated right away. You can fine-tune everything later under **Configure**.

init.title: BatteryBrain options
init.description: Changes apply immediately; collected history is kept.

discovery.name: Discovery
discovery.description: Which entities count as batteries. Sensors and binary sensors with the battery device class are always included.

data_description.scan_battery_level_attr: Also monitor entities that only report their battery as a battery_level attribute (e.g. some device trackers).
data_description.include_voltage_sensors: Monitor voltage sensors between 0.3 V and 20 V as batteries. Turn off if non-battery voltages (e.g. a 3.3 V supply of an ESP board) show up.

exclusions.name: Exclusions
exclusions.description: Batteries you don't want to monitor.

data_description.exclude_integrations: Ignore all batteries of these integrations (e.g. Mobile App for phones).

data.binary_low_is_critical: Low signal of on/off battery sensors is critical

data_description.alert_mode: Smart: each battery is rated by how it drains, including a forecast of when it will be empty. Low level only: a battery only becomes a warning at or below the level below, and critical at half of it. Forecasts are still shown in the attributes.
data_description.warning_threshold: Only used with "Low level only". Voltage and on/off battery sensors and unreachable batteries are rated the same in both modes.
data_description.binary_low_is_critical: Battery sensors that only report low/normal count as critical as soon as they report low. Otherwise they are a warning first and critical after 3 days.

data_description.developer_mode: Writes a detailed debug log and adds developer tools. Only enable this when asked to for an error analysis.

test_mode.name: Test Mode (DO NOT USE — destroys sensor data)
